preseason.note: Dihitung dari timer in-game 10d 09:42:20 pada 2026-11-19 ~16:17 UTC; jatuh tepat di 00:00 waktu server (UTC-2).

desc.id: Target harian satu warzone selama 7 hari. Tiap target yang tercapai membuka info season (klan, War Merit, Alliance Pact, Altar) dan hadiah.
desc.en: Seven daily warzone-wide goals. Each one you clear reveals season info (clans, War Merit, Alliance Pacts, Altars) and a reward.

desc.id: Pratinjau buff selama season, termasuk skin base Enchanted Fungus dan promosi Braz ke UR.
desc.en: Preview of the season's buffs, including the Enchanted Fungus base skin and Braz's UR promotion.

desc.id: Pilih satu jendela pertempuran di mana kota dan wilayah aliansi tidak bisa diserang. Atur di Alliance → Settings → Alliance Safe Time.
desc.en: Pick one battle window when your alliance's cities and territory can't be attacked. Set it in Alliance → Settings → Alliance Safe Time.

desc.id: Membagi dua grup warzone ke faksi Deepwood dan Wetland lewat Faction Reveal Stage.
desc.en: Assigns the two warzone groups to the Deepwood and Wetland factions via the Faction Reveal Stage.

desc.id: Minggu ke-2 pra-musim, hari 5 pukul 12:00 waktu server. Semua aliansi boleh ikut tanpa wilayah bersebelahan; pemenangnya jadi Presiden sepanjang off-season.
desc.en: Pre-season week 2, day 5 at 12:00 server time. Any alliance can join without adjacent land; the winner holds President through the off-season.

desc.id: Wajib untuk ikut Global Expedition. Prioritaskan sebelum season dimulai.
desc.en: Required for Global Expedition. Prioritise it before the season starts.
